quest.title: Sightseeing With Friends: A Trip to Fontaine
quest.description: After wrapping up your trip through Natlan, you and your Fungi friends are off to the next destination on Paimon's list...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fontaine's photography pros have raved about this place like, a million times! They say it's one of the best photo spots to appreciate the nation's tidy and balanced layout!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's true that we rarely see it from this angle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Our Fungi friends are totally entranced... Guess Haniyyah didn't get to bring them here last time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then, let's get started. Those popular landscape paintings from earlier should help spark some ideas for our Fungi friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Natlan trip went great! Hmm, Paimon thinks we can take our Fungi buddies on a grand tour of Fontaine next!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even if Haniyyah's already taken our Fungi friends there, Paimon the Expert Guide has got a few must-see gems to recommend!
